cohort: 35 pregnant/puerperal patients with severe COVID-19 admitted to a third-level ICU
finding: Pregnant women with severe COVID-19 admitted to the ICU had a high rate of preterm birth (80.8%), with 34.3% requiring IMV and a maternal mortality rate of 14.3%.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was high (74.3%) among the pregnant women with COVID-19 in the ICU, but the study found no specific gestational week for better maternal outcomes with C/S.
